label: Accessible absence coverage rules out being without a source of dependence
description: Re-presentation of the dependence-to-real-impossibility premise, not independent support for it (#2103). If x depends for its being on y and could exist without y, the realization premise supplies an accessible contrast world. Coverage selects it, so soundness implies x is absent there, contradicting the witness. With the selector a free parameter, soundness and coverage hold for some selector exactly when 000e1f65 holds with being-without read as accessible contrast, CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 (Lean track_cover_iff_strict). So the argument derives 000e1f65 from its own accessibility reading and the one-way realization bridge 11dc5069; the counterfactual selection adds no constraint unless a selector is fixed independently. Its warrant for 000e1f65 is that of the accessibility reading plus 11dc5069. Its restates_conclusion marker (#2190) makes the frontier close 000e1f65 through it only by rule (d), when every premise is closed. Accessibility stays distinct from intervention outcomes, and the argument leaves the shared dependence primitive and the strict-ground map untouched.

restates_conclusion.note: With the selector existentially closed, soundness 2bdb0be1 and coverage 06047f4c hold exactly when 000e1f65 holds at being-without read as accessible contrast (CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1), so these two premises re-present that instance of the conclusion. The realization premise 11dc5069 is not restated: it is the one-way bridge from the conclusion's being-without to accessible contrast. The derivation's warrant for 000e1f65 is that of its accessible-contrast instance plus 11dc5069.
